items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and create no new queue work this cycle. Highest-leverage product opportunities, to retain as future backlog themes, are: (1) control-plane execution integrity—canonical lineage, deduplication, ownership, retry gates, and repair-or-close states; current evidence shows 197 approved proposals without execution and 46 open failure follow-ups; (2) measurement readiness—automatically distinguish deployed, measurable, measured, proven, and unknown states; 27 deployed improvements await measurement, with only 5 measured and 1 proven; (3) restore existing operations/fleet-doctor result availability so reliability is observable without inventing telemetry; (4) operator-facing capability and routing matrix to reduce blocked handoffs caused by unavailable roles; and (5) AI-cost-aware work selection using existing usage records, preserving unknown ROI and margin. Prioritize by operator time saved, reliability, adoption, reversibility, and measurable outcome. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, security evidence, and failed-work repair-or-close review; do not create duplicate telemetry, requeue failures, add spend, change schedules, or deploy.
